githubTokenPrecedence.rule: start (a per-session runtime) takes the first of: the client's COUNTINGHOUSE_GITHUB_TOKEN, the stored token, gh auth token, the client's GITHUB_TOKEN. The daemon's runtime, which no client environment reaches, takes the stored token, else gh's, at its start. The conditions check sends the keyed hash of the token start would choose, except that a gh login is sent as null (the daemon has it too): so token is mac(env), mac(stored), null or mac(GITHUB_TOKEN). The session shares when token is null (the daemon's, whatever it holds), or when token is the hash of the token the daemon holds; otherwise own-runtime (token). A stored token that fails its file checks counts as none

cases.why: a stored token, the daemon started on it
a stored token added while the daemon runs on gh's: its own runtime until the daemon restarts
the client sets COUNTINGHOUSE_GITHUB_TOKEN beside a stored one
GITHUB_TOKEN beside a gh login chooses nothing
GITHUB_TOKEN beside a stored token chooses nothing
GITHUB_TOKEN with neither a stored token nor gh
a stored token removed while the daemon still runs on it: null is the daemon's, until its restart (the restart request)
a stored token whose file fails its checks counts as none
